title: Chain
description: A settlement domain with its own address format. NOT MODELLED AS AN ENTITY in the services today: the only code-side registry is apps/reconciler/src/chains.rs, which is private to the reconciler and enriched with RPC endpoints, token ids and the LLAMA_IDS price mapping. Nothing else in the repo agrees with it, which is why the canonical chain_id is required here.

name.description: Lowercase canonical label as wallets.go stores it (e.g. 'ethereum').

chain_numeric_id.description: EVM chain id, as DefiLlama's LlamaChain.chainId carries it; null for non-EVM.
